name: model_metadata_is_local_endpoint
notes: Local-endpoint detection (LIVE agent/model_metadata.py::is_local_endpoint vs traced copy of src/agent/provider_metadata.c::is_local_endpoint). Ladder: empty guard, host V event, known-local hosts, container DNS suffixes, IPv4 parse + seven range rungs (loopback/RFC1918 x2/link-local/CGNAT/0-net), IPv6 parse guard. The twin decomposes LIVE semantics (urlparse hostname + ipaddress octets) in C rung order AND asserts equality with a direct LIVE call on every input. KNOWN DIVERGENCES (documented, avoided by inputs): LIVE treats dot-less hostnames as local and accepts broader suffix forms; C has neither rule — inputs use dotted/IP/localist hosts only. Bare IPv6 literals excluded from this gate.
